Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chwizz wrote:
>
> This is the sentence I took from the On-line rules...
> What happens when we recruit Rom Gypsies, or Survivalist ?
> Can they use their special ability the turn they're recruited ?
> Althought they cannot act ?

Yes. The only restriction is on taking actions. Special abilities
are not affected (except for actions, of course).
